item.title: Coaching with AI: asking questions instead of writing & fixing
item.dc:creator: Riley Writer
item.description: Tutors can show students how to use a chatbot as a coach. The student asks for questions, not for sentences. Then they revise on their own.

item.title: Non-directive tutoring in the writing center
item.dc:creator: Sam Scholar
item.description: Peer tutors who ask open questions help writers own their ideas. This is a core idea in writing center pedagogy.

item.title: Helping students revise with feedback they can use
item.description: Students improve when feedback names one next step. Try a short revision plan after each session.

item.title: Five quick teaching tips for the first week
item.description: Start with a clear assignment prompt. Share a rubric early.
